verdict.rationale: Render documents three relevant pieces. Architecture can be defined and versioned in a single Blueprint YAML file. Every change or pull request gets an ephemeral preview environment for review. The docs also list a Rollbacks feature. These apply to deployed services and infrastructure in general rather than to automations or workflows specifically, and the rollback evidence is only a docs heading. Missing for 10: explicit versioning, review, and rollback of workflow tasks or automations; detail on rollback behavior; independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations

citations.quote: Define, deploy, and version your entire architecture with a single YAML file.
Iterate quickly with ephemeral previews of your entire application architecture for every change.
every pull request gets its own running copy of the application stack.
